table_context_mentions_column_and_precis.original_text: business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_youtube__channel_demographics using date_day, video_id, country_code, age_group, views_percentage. - Keep only age_group in {''13-17'',''18-24'',''25-34'',''35-44'',''45-54'',''55-64'',''65-''}. - Aggregate views_percentage by (date_day, video_id, country_code, age_group) to get views_pct: - Null inputs are ignored in the sum; if all inputs are null for a group, views_pct is null. - Multiple rows for the same keys are combined by summation only. - For each (date_day, video_id, country_code), compute pct_sum as the sum of views_pct across the kept age groups: - Null views_pct are ignored; pct_sum is null only when all views_pct are null in the partition. - Normalize per age_group: - If pct_sum > 0, set pct_norm = views_pct / pct_sum and clamp to the range [0.0, 1.0]. - If pct_sum <= 0 or pct_sum is null, set pct_norm = 0.0. - No rounding; double precision is retained. - Pivot to age columns (''13-17'',''18-24'',''25-34'',''35-44'',''45-54'',''55-64'',''65-'') by summing pct_norm for rows matching each age label within (date_day, video_id, country_code): - If no row exists for an age label, the column is null. - If a row exists but pct_sum <= 0 or pct_sum is null, the column is 0.0. - If pct_sum > 0 but that age group’s views_pct is missing, the column is null (because pct_norm is null). - Set pct_total_before_normalization to the total of views_pct across the kept age groups for the (date_day, video_id, country_code); it is null only when all views_pct are null. - Output includes only (date_day, video_id, country_code) combinations that have at least one kept age group after filtering.'
